0022600095.text: Neither the Dallas Mavericks nor the Indiana Pacers has played a 2026-27 game yet. The Mavericks, the away side, are without Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Jett Howard (calf), Santi Aldama (knee) and Tarik Biberovic (heel), while the Pacers are missing Aaron Nesmith (hamstring strain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring). Dallas won both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 134-130 in Indianapolis on February 22, 2026, and no games have been played yet in this season's series.
